entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so upset. I need to return it, and I'm afraid I missed the window. I really hope you can help me.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, the band works fine. It's a personal issue. We had a sudden family emergency. My husband had to be rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he is doing okay.

Thank you. He's recovering, but it was very serious. He was supposed to leave for his deployment next month, so this whole thing has been a nightmare. I was planning to return the band before all this, but I've been at the hospital constantly.

That sounds incredibly stressful. I completely understand. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see you received the item 19 days ago. Let me check the official return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I'm just really hoping for some good news. With all these unexpected medical bills, I was really counting on getting that money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
Alright, I've just reviewed our policy. It looks like you're in luck. Our knowledge base states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Wait, really? Ninety days? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was just a few days too late.
Not at all. Since you're only on day 19, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now. No exception needed.
That is such a relief. Isaac, you have no idea. Thank you so much for your help.
It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could take this one thing off your plate. I'm sending the prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, so much.
You are very welcome. I wish your husband a full and speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
